itemprop="description" class="rtltextaligneligible">Wipro Limited (NYSE: WIT, BSE: 507685, NSE: WIPRO) is a leading technology services and consulting company focused on building innovative solutions that address clients’ most complex digital transformation needs. Leveraging our holistic portfolio of capabilities in consulting, design, engineering, and operations, we help clients realize their boldest ambitions and build future-ready, sustainable businesses. With over 230,000 employees and business partners across 65 countries, we deliver on the promise of helping our customers, colleagues, and communities thrive in an ever-changing world. For additional information, visit us at www.wipro.com.
Job Description  
 Role Purpose 
 The purpose of the role is to provide effective technical support to the process and actively resolve client issues directly or through timely escalation to meet process SLAs. 
͏  
As the role is part of team, the new hire is expected to spend most of the time in streamlining Anaplan, iLevel and Chatham dependent processes and optimizing existing systems/template setup to create consistent and efficient reporting for U.S. region
Key Responsibilities:
Net Debt 
• Facilitate consolidation, reconciliation and submission of net debt inputs into DCF models
• Net debt inputs include but are not limited to: fund line of credit, NAV facilities, cash balances and other assets & liabilities 
Fund Accounting 
• Perform fund inception to date upload of all fund cashflows for U.S. opportunistic and open-ended funds
• Perform one-time reconciliation with DCF models against Anaplan and Niagara extracts
• Report and investigate into any differences between DCF models and fund accounting systems
• Perform quarterly fund accounting on actual and accrual-based capital calls and distributions 
Debt Management
• Design and create an excel template on property-level Chatham inputs
• Liaise with Revantage Capital Market Team to confirm debt movements
• Ensure debt balances tie to investments before generating summary for business teams 
Essential Skills & Experience:
• Master’s degree – Major/Minor in Finance
• Exceptional quantitative aptitude and skill set with a mastery of Microsoft Office applications
• Previous background with valuations 
• ChathamDirect / iLevel / iLevel Cash Transactions Module proficiency 
• Ability to work as an individual contributor and manage multiple priorities in a fast paced, fluid environment
• Rigorous analytical mindset with a high level of intellectual curiosity, self-learning ability and excellent problem-solving skills 
• Acute focus on attention to detail, accuracy, and data validation 
• Effective communication skills (listening, verbal, and written)
• Excellent interpersonal and teamwork skills
• Sound judgment and discretion
• Strong initiative, energy and confidence completing assignments with limited supervision

Job Description  
 The Opportunity: 
This is a great opportunity to join a growing Finance team in an international alternative investments group which has structured certain of its investments through the client project for more than 15 years. This role offers interesting and challenging tasks from both a technical and soft skills perspective and an opportunity to work in a dynamic and international environment.
We are looking to recruit Finance Analyst to join our offshore Center of Excellence (COE) in India and support the Finance team.
The role involves hands-on accounting, finance and reporting support for client-based investment structures, working closely with onshore teams in a dynamic international environment. 
This position is suitable for candidates with 2–5 years of experience, looking to deepen their exposure to international finance and progressively take ownership of recurring processes. 
 Key Responsibilities:
1. Accounting & Finance Support 
• Perform day-to-day accounting activities for client entities under established procedures 
• Maintain GL-level accounting for expenses, cash, intercompany balances and financing activities 
• Prepare and review reconciliations, including cash, intercompany balances and loan-related movements 
• Prepare support files for financial statements and contribute to financial analysis
 2. Cash & Payment process 
• Prepare payment support files and coordinate payment execution with onshore teams • Monitor cash positions and contribute to cash forecasting and liquidity tracking
• Follow up on payment status and investigate discrepancies 
3. Reporting, Controls & Data Quality 
• Own and maintain finance trackers and control files 
• Prepare periodic management reports and ad-hoc financial analyses
• Ensure accuracy, completeness and consistency of financial data 
 4. Corporate & Cross-Team Coordination 
• Prepare corporate documentation and internal approvals related to finance activities 
• Liaise directly with onshore finance teams to collect, clarify and validate information 
• Contribute actively to process improvements and documentation updates 
 5. Ownership & Team Contribution 
• Take ownership of recurring finance processes within the assigned scope 
• Act as a first-level point of contact for operational finance topics within the COE
 • Support and guide junior team members (e.g. Management Trainees) when required 
 Mandatory Skills: Financial Planning & Analysis.
 Experience: 1-3 Years.
